actual_Boolean_family: f=2 product_{j=1}^r OR_{w_j}(X_j)-1 on disjoint blocks; all actual positive prime conjunctions choose one positive variable per block
domain: Small direct tables (r,w)=(2,2),(3,2),(2,3); every output subset; three deterministic feasible reference vectors. Analytic family w=4..8, r=2^w, t=0..r blocks of width w+1 and the rest width w.
case_count: 3 complete small Boolean tables; 9 fixed references; all nonempty root subsets for at most9 primes and every nonempty output; 501 heterogeneous parameter orbits. Pilot uses (r,w)=(2,2), all3 references and w=4,t in {0,8,16}.
symmetry: No reduction for small truth/root tables. Permuting disjoint clauses identifies width patterns with the same t; the analytic theorem permits arbitrary feasible nonuniform lambda and arbitrary orders.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh and physical flips; exact Fraction root priors and component factorization; rational probability upper bounds and analytic logarithm inequalities. No floating-point sign acceptance.
targets: Full actual queue root-component upper bound, retained D; all-prime cost/I>r/7; independent spectral entropy upper<=6I. Universal proofs are analytic, not inferred from finite cases.
